Message.Name: Quote Message
Message.Description: Tradelogiq's BBO will broadcast real-time updates every time Tradelogiq's top of book changes.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved

Field.Name: Stock Symbol
Field.Description: Stock Identifier for which BBO quotation message is being generated

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Best Bid Price
Field.Description: Denotes best bid price on Tradelogiq's books either OMEGA or LYNX

Field.Name: Best Bid Size
Field.Description: Denotes the total number of shares available for display on Tradelogiq's order books at the best bid price

Field.Name: Best Ask Price
Field.Description: Denotes best ask price on Tradelogiq's order books either OMEGA or LYNX

Field.Name: Best Ask Size
Field.Description: Denotes the total number of shares available for display on Tradelogiq's order books at the best ask price

Message.Name: Trade Report Message
Message.Description: Relays all transactions available from or reported by Tradelogiq's two trading books for the current business day.

Field.Name: Conditions
Field.Description: Trade condition codes, W for Bypass, X for Internal Cross and E for Odd Lot. Note: Field may be blank

Field.Name: Stock Symbol
Field.Description: Stock Identifier

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Trade ID
Field.Description: Indicates the internal number of the given trade transaction

Field.Name: Trade Price
Field.Description: The price associated with the trade transaction being reported.

Field.Name: Trade Size
Field.Description: Number of shares on the trade transaction

Field.Name: Buy Broker
Field.Description: Buy Side Broker Number or 1 for Anonymous

Field.Name: Sell Broker
Field.Description: Sell Side Broker Number or 1 for Anonymous

Message.Name: Trade Bust Message
Message.Description: If trade is cancelled or busted during the day Trade Bust Message will be sent.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved

Field.Name: Stock Symbol
Field.Description: Stock Symbol

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Trade ID
Field.Description: Indicates the internal number of the given trade transaction

Message.Name: Trade Correction Message
Message.Description: Trade amendments during the day will send this message.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved

Field.Name: Stock Symbol
Field.Description: Stock Identifier

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Original Trade ID
Field.Description: Original internal number of the given trade transaction

Field.Name: Original Trade Price
Field.Description: Original price associated with the trade transaction

Field.Name: Original Trade Size
Field.Description: Trade Size reported on the original trade transaction

Field.Name: Corrected Trade Price
Field.Description: Price associated with the trade correction reported

Field.Name: Corrected Trade Size
Field.Description: Number of shares with the trade correction

Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: The system event message is used to signal a market or a data feed handler event.

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: See Below For codes

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Message.Name: Stock Directory Message
Message.Description: At start of each trading day, OSI disseminates stock directory messages for supported securities.

Field.Name: Market
Field.Description: Indicates the listing market of security

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol on Omega ATS and Lynx ATS

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Board Lot Size
Field.Description: Indicates a board lot size

Field.Name: Instrument ID
Field.Description: Internal instrument identifier for Omega ATS and Lynx ATS

Field.Name: Shortable
Field.Description: Indicates the short status of a security

Field.Name: Dividend Indicator
Field.Description: Dividend frequency of the security

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Indicates currency for the symbol

Message.Name: Extended Stock Directory Message
Message.Description: Extended Stock Directory are for Special stock symbols eg warrants debentures rights.

Field.Name: Market
Field.Description: Indicates the listing market of security

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol on Omega ATS and Lynx ATS

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Board Lot Size
Field.Description: Indicates a board lot size

Field.Name: Instrument ID
Field.Description: Internal instrument identifier for Omega ATS and Lynx ATS

Field.Name: Shortable
Field.Description: Indicates the short status of a security

Field.Name: Frequency
Field.Description: Dividend frequency of the security

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Indicates currency for the symbol

Field.Name: Security Type
Field.Description: Instrument class of the security

Field.Name: Expiry Date
Field.Description: Date of expiry in the format YYYYMMDD

Field.Name: Description
Field.Description: Description of Security

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved

Message.Name: Stock Status Message
Message.Description: This message indicates the current trading status of a stock.

Field.Name: Trading State
Field.Description: The current trading state for the issue

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol on Omega ATS and Lynx ATS

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Reason
Field.Description: Reason the security is halted. Note: Field may be blank

Value.Name: Start of Messages
Value.Description: The start if day message is the first message sent out in a trading day

Value.Name: Start of System Hours
Value.Description: This message indicate that Tradelogiq order books are Open and ready to start accepting order

Value.Name: Start of Market Hours
Value.Description: This message is intended to indicate that Market Hours order are available for execution

Value.Name: End of Market Hours
Value.Description: This message is intended to indicate that Market Hours are no longer available for execution

Value.Name: End of System Hours
Value.Description: It indicates that Tradelogiq order books are now closed and will not accept new orders

Value.Name: End of Messages
Value.Description: This is always the last message sent in any trading day.

Value.Name: Trading Halted
Value.Description: Trading Halted due to Market-Wide Circuit Breaker

Value.Name: Trading Resumed
Value.Description: Trading Resumed following Market-Wide Circuit Breaker
